description:
Metra TikTok Patches v0.14.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

This release adds default playback speeds and a custom speed menu, automatic video advance, selected-quality downloads, and paired subtitle files. Caption styling, split comments on wider windows and country-aligned locale/timezone controls are included.

Settings now have backup, restore, reset and undo. Feature Gate Lab applies changes without confirmation prompts and keeps recovery for resets and imports. Inbox category switches work across languages and restore hidden rows immediately when disabled. The release also includes gate recording, screenshot controls and fixes for feed and interaction behavior.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key. Phone-specific rendering, playback and account behavior still need the checks listed in the local blocked roadmap.

Bulk deletion of posted comment history remains queued and is not included in this release.

Validation: 120 runtime tests passed. The bundle contains 58 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads. UI verification used offscreen Android rendering.
